question: Show all pairs of entertainers and customers who each have up to three style strengths or preferences, where the first and second style preferences of the customers match the first and second style strengths of the entertainers (or in reverse order). Only return the entertainer’s stage name and the customer’s last name
sql:
-- Let's verify the match details for each pair found
WITH ent_first_second AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID,
           MAX(CASE WHEN StyleStrength = 1 THEN StyleID END) AS first_strength_style,
           MAX(CASE WHEN StyleStrength = 2 THEN StyleID END) AS second_strength_style
    FROM Entertainer_Styles
    GROUP BY EntertainerID
    HAVING COUNT(*) <= 3
),
cust_first_second AS (
    SELECT CustomerID,
           MAX(CASE WHEN PreferenceSeq = 1 THEN StyleID END) AS first_pref_style,
           MAX(CASE WHEN PreferenceSeq = 2 THEN StyleID END) AS second_pref_style
    FROM Musical_Preferences
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    HAVING COUNT(*) <= 3
)
SELECT e.EntStageName, c.CustLastName,
       ef.first_strength_style as ent_first, ef.second_strength_style as ent_second,
       cf.first_pref_style as cust_first, cf.second_pref_style as cust_second
FROM ent_first_second ef
JOIN cust_first_second cf ON 1=1
JOIN Entertainers e ON ef.EntertainerID = e.EntertainerID
JOIN Customers c ON cf.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE (ef.first_strength_style = cf.first_pref_style AND ef.second_strength_style = cf.second_pref_style)
   OR (ef.first_strength_style = cf.second_pref_style AND ef.second_strength_style = cf.first_pref_style)
ORDER BY e.EntStageName, c.CustLastName
